payload.title: File:Jane (composite photo).jpg
payload.artist_html: Matt Celeskey from Albuquerque
payload.description_html:
Originally classified as juvenile Tyrannosaurus, now named as a second species of Nanotyrannus or Stygivenator, the N. lethaeus or S. lethaeus.

Cast skeleton with reconstructed head. At the Cleveland Museum of Natural History.
